title: Default typeface – Arial
slide_intent: Define a fallback that keeps routine communications readable when the brand typeface is unavailable.
strategic_value: An explicit fallback can keep internal documents and emails consistent without diluting the face used in professionally designed work.
demonstration: Two matched character specimens compare Arial Regular and Bold. A separate column defines when the substitution applies.
practical_value: Use Arial for email or internally produced documents when Caslon Doric is unavailable. Use Caslon Doric where the production environment supports it.

content_islands.spec: Place the heading and a short explanation of installation and channel limits at the left.
